meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: UOL home page: ad slots, LGPD bar, photos, video cards, related lists, Flash Feed
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, from saved DOM snapshots of uol.com.br (home page) taken with headless Chrome, iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA (Brazilian Portuguese). The network became unavailable afterwards, so article pages and search were not loaded.

Class names on UOL are readable BEM-style names (photograph__container, cardVideo, relatedList, flashFeed), so they are used directly.

- **Cookie banners**: .banner-lgpd-consent-container, the LGPD bar, 1 on phone, 0 on desktop (LIVE).
- **Ads**: div[id^=banner-] 25 on phone and 17 on desktop (banner areas, native slot, anchor area), div[id^=google_ads_iframe] 4 each, iframe[aria-label=Advertisement] 2 phone and 1 desktop. .up-floating (the floating anchor ad) 1 on phone. .bannerChannelUol 1 (UOL's own promo). All LIVE.
- **Photos** (Show/Blur/Hide): picture.photograph__container, 159 on phone and 165 on desktop (LIVE).
- **Video cards**: article.cardVideo 3 on both (LIVE). The news-player elements are inside them.
- **Related lists**: aside.relatedList 6 on both (LIVE). **Flash Feed**: section.flashFeed 1 on both (LIVE).

The login panel (.messagesContainer.loginbox, fixed to the viewport on both layouts) is deliberately left alone. Whether the players autoplay was not observed. Not verified: article pages, UOL mail and other UOL sites, logged-in views.
